name: El Villar de Arnedo (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally into three bands from the upper fly to the lower hoist, green at the upper hoist, yellow in the centre and crimson at the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of El Villar de Arnedo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: green area at the upper hoist
crimson area at the lower hoist
